decision: Approve leading-status-badge for optional NowCard statusBadge rendered before the generated heading.

evidence.channel: Owner approval recorded in docs/components/now-card/v0.1/badge-order-approval.md and odd/tasks/web-catalog.md L20
evidence.interpretation: Scoped naming approval only, not native review authority.

convention.name: statusBadge
convention.meaning: Optional consumer-supplied non-interactive status node rendered before a component primary heading.
convention.whenToUse: A heading-owning content card renders a meaningful status Badge composition before its heading without inspecting child content.
convention.avoid: Interactive controls, decorative icons, plain-text eyebrows, trailing content or built-in status words.
